quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct conclusion.
quests.passage: Ravi's manager asked him to lead the new project after seeing how well he handled the last one. Ravi spent extra hours preparing a detailed plan before the first meeting.
options: Ravi wanted to do a good job leading the new project.
Ravi refused to lead the new project.
Ravi's manager was unhappy with his previous work.
Ravi skipped the first meeting.
quests.correctAnswer: Ravi wanted to do a good job leading the new project.
quests.hint: Notice the extra effort Ravi put into preparing before the meeting.
quests.explanation: Ravi spent extra hours preparing a detailed plan, which shows he cared about doing well as the new project leader.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct conclusion.
quests.passage: The new smart thermostat learns a family's daily schedule and adjusts the temperature automatically. After installing it, the Alvarez family noticed their energy bill was lower than the month before.
options: The thermostat made the family's energy bill higher.
The Alvarez family removed the new thermostat.
The family is now paying less for energy each month.
Energy bills are never affected by thermostats.
quests.correctAnswer: The family is now paying less for energy each month.
quests.hint: Compare the family's energy bill before and after installing the device.
quests.explanation: Right after installing the smart thermostat, the family's energy bill dropped, suggesting the device helped them use less energy.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct conclusion.
quests.passage: Tourists usually avoid the old fishing village because there is no direct train there. After a new highway opened last spring, the number of visitors tripled within a few months.
options: The new highway kept tourists away from the village.
The village removed the highway shortly after it opened.
Visiting the village has become easier since the highway opened.
Visitor numbers stayed the same after the highway opened.
quests.correctAnswer: Visiting the village has become easier since the highway opened.
quests.hint: Think about how a new road might change how easily people can visit a place.
quests.explanation: Visitor numbers tripled soon after the highway opened, suggesting the improved access brought more tourists to the village.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct conclusion.
quests.passage: Omar used to drink four cups of coffee every afternoon and had trouble falling asleep at night. After cutting back to one cup in the morning, he has been sleeping through the night.
options: Drinking less coffee made Omar sleep worse.
Omar stopped drinking coffee completely.
Omar is sleeping better since he cut back on afternoon coffee.
Omar's sleep problems were unrelated to his coffee habit.
quests.correctAnswer: Omar is sleeping better since he cut back on afternoon coffee.
quests.hint: Compare Omar's coffee habits with his sleep before and after the change.
quests.explanation: Omar's sleep improved only after he cut back on afternoon coffee, suggesting the change in habit was the reason.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct conclusion.
quests.passage: The amusement park added a new roller coaster this summer. Since it opened, the line for that ride has stretched over two hours long every single day.
options: The new roller coaster has become extremely popular.
The new roller coaster has very few visitors.
The amusement park removed the roller coaster.
Visitors avoid the new ride completely.
quests.correctAnswer: The new roller coaster has become extremely popular.
quests.hint: Think about what a two-hour line every day tells you about the ride.
quests.explanation: A two-hour wait every day shows that a large number of visitors want to try the new roller coaster.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct conclusion.
quests.passage: Every Friday, Noah takes out the recycling bins the night before pickup. Last Friday, he forgot, and the bins were still full when the truck came and went.
options: The recycling truck waited for Noah to bring out the bins.
Noah remembered to take out the bins as usual.
The recycling was not collected last Friday.
The recycling truck comes twice a week.
quests.correctAnswer: The recycling was not collected last Friday.
quests.hint: Think about what happens if the bins are not outside when the truck arrives.
quests.explanation: Because Noah forgot to put the bins out, the truck came and went without collecting the recycling.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct conclusion.
quests.passage: The food truck used to park downtown every day but rarely had customers. After moving to the spot near the university, it now sells out of food within two hours of opening.
options: The food truck now has far more customers than it used to.
The food truck lost customers after moving locations.
The food truck closed down after the move.
Where a business is located makes no difference to its customers.
quests.correctAnswer: The food truck now has far more customers than it used to.
quests.hint: Compare how the food truck did before and after changing its location.
quests.explanation: The food truck barely had customers downtown but now sells out quickly near the university, showing the new location brought in more business.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct conclusion.
quests.passage: Aunt Rosa used to visit twice a year and always seemed rushed. Since retiring last spring, she has stayed for two full weeks during each visit and cooks dinner for the whole family every night.
options: Aunt Rosa visits less often since retiring.
Aunt Rosa stopped visiting the family after retiring.
Retirement had no effect on Aunt Rosa's visits.
Aunt Rosa now has more time to spend with her family.
quests.correctAnswer: Aunt Rosa now has more time to spend with her family.
quests.hint: Think about what retiring might change about someone's free time.
quests.explanation: After retiring, Aunt Rosa began staying much longer and cooking every night, showing she now has more time for her family.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct conclusion.
quests.passage: The school introduced a twenty-minute reading period every morning this year. By the end of the semester, the librarian reported that book checkouts had increased by half.
options: Book checkouts dropped after the reading period started.
Students are checking out more books than they used to.
The school cancelled the reading period after one week.
Students stopped visiting the library this year.
quests.correctAnswer: Students are checking out more books than they used to.
quests.hint: Notice what changed at school right before checkouts increased.
quests.explanation: Book checkouts rose after the school added a daily reading period, suggesting the new routine encouraged students to read more.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct conclusion.
quests.passage: The electronics store used to display prices only in small print near the shelf. After adding large, clear price tags to every item, staff noticed far fewer customers asking where to find prices.
options: The larger price tags confused customers even more.
Customers now have an easier time finding prices in the store.
The store removed all price tags completely.
Customers stopped asking questions about anything in the store.
quests.correctAnswer: Customers now have an easier time finding prices in the store.
quests.hint: Think about why fewer customers would need to ask about prices.
quests.explanation: Once prices became large and clear, fewer customers needed to ask where to find them, showing the new tags solved the problem.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct conclusion.
quests.passage: Before the update, the app crashed several times a day for most users. Support tickets about crashes dropped to almost zero within a week of the update being released.
options: The update made the app crash more often.
The app was removed from stores after the update.
The update appears to have fixed the app's crashing problem.
Crashing complaints had nothing to do with the update.
quests.correctAnswer: The update appears to have fixed the app's crashing problem.
quests.hint: Compare the number of crash complaints before and after the update.
quests.explanation: Crash complaints nearly disappeared right after the update, strongly suggesting the update fixed the problem users were having.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct conclusion.
quests.passage: The office used to hold meetings that often ran over an hour with no clear agenda. After managers started sending a written agenda beforehand, most meetings now end within thirty minutes.
options: Meetings now take longer than they used to.
Meetings are shorter and better organized than they used to be.
The office stopped holding meetings altogether.
Written agendas made meetings more confusing.
quests.correctAnswer: Meetings are shorter and better organized than they used to be.
quests.hint: Compare how long meetings lasted before and after the change.
quests.explanation: Meetings became much shorter after managers began sharing a written agenda beforehand, showing the agenda helped keep things efficient.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct conclusion.
quests.passage: The ferry to the island used to run only twice a day and was often full. Since the company added two more daily trips, passengers say they rarely have trouble finding a seat.
options: The extra trips made the ferry more crowded.
Passengers now have an easier time finding a seat on the ferry.
The ferry company reduced the number of daily trips.
Passengers stopped taking the ferry after the change.
quests.correctAnswer: Passengers now have an easier time finding a seat on the ferry.
quests.hint: Think about how adding more trips would affect how crowded each one is.
quests.explanation: With more daily trips available, passengers are spread out more and now rarely struggle to find a seat.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct conclusion.
quests.passage: The clinic used to have a waiting room full of patients every morning, with long delays. After hiring two more nurses, most patients are now seen within fifteen minutes of arriving.
options: Wait times got longer after the new nurses were hired.
Patients are waiting much less time to be seen than before.
The clinic stopped accepting new patients.
The number of nurses has no effect on wait times.
quests.correctAnswer: Patients are waiting much less time to be seen than before.
quests.hint: Compare how long patients waited before and after the clinic hired more staff.
quests.explanation: Patient wait times dropped sharply after two more nurses were hired, showing the extra staff helped things move faster.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct conclusion.
quests.passage: The podcast used to release new episodes once a month and had a small audience. After switching to a weekly schedule, its download numbers grew to ten times what they were before.
options: The podcast's audience has grown considerably larger.
The podcast lost most of its listeners after the schedule change.
The podcast stopped releasing new episodes.
How often a podcast releases episodes does not affect its audience.
quests.correctAnswer: The podcast's audience has grown considerably larger.
quests.hint: Compare the podcast's audience size before and after the schedule changed.
quests.explanation: Downloads grew ten times larger after the podcast began releasing episodes weekly, showing the new schedule attracted more listeners.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct conclusion.
quests.passage: Every winter, ice forms on the steps outside Mateo's apartment building. This year, after the building manager started spreading salt each evening, no one has slipped on the steps.
options: More people have slipped on the steps this year.
The building manager stopped clearing the steps.
Spreading salt on the steps has helped prevent falls.
Salt has no effect on icy surfaces.
quests.correctAnswer: Spreading salt on the steps has helped prevent falls.
quests.hint: Think about what salt usually does to ice on a surface.
quests.explanation: Since the manager began spreading salt each evening, no one has slipped, showing the salt has been preventing falls on the icy steps.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct conclusion.
quests.passage: The school cafeteria replaced fried snacks with fresh fruit and vegetable options this term. Staff have noticed far less food left uneaten on students' trays at the end of lunch.
options: Students are throwing away more food than before.
Students seem to be eating more of their food since the change.
The cafeteria removed all fruit and vegetables.
The change in menu made no difference to students.
quests.correctAnswer: Students seem to be eating more of their food since the change.
quests.hint: Think about what less leftover food on trays suggests about the meals.
quests.explanation: Less food is being left uneaten since the menu changed, suggesting students are enjoying and finishing more of their meals.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct conclusion.
quests.passage: The Nguyen cousins never spent time together as children because they lived in different countries. Now that they are adults living in the same city, they meet for dinner every week.
options: The cousins have grown apart since moving to the same city.
The cousins still live in different countries.
The cousins have grown closer now that they live nearby.
The cousins have never met each other.
quests.correctAnswer: The cousins have grown closer now that they live nearby.
quests.hint: Compare the cousins' relationship as children with their relationship now.
quests.explanation: Living far apart kept the cousins from spending time together, but now that they live in the same city, they meet weekly, showing they've grown closer.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct conclusion.
quests.passage: The university library used to close at 9 p.m., and students often complained they didn't have enough time to study. After extending hours to midnight, complaints about study time have nearly disappeared.
options: Complaints about study time increased after the change.
The library returned to closing at 9 p.m.
Library hours have no connection to student complaints.
Students now have enough time in the library to study.
quests.correctAnswer: Students now have enough time in the library to study.
quests.hint: Compare student complaints before and after the library extended its hours.
quests.explanation: Complaints about study time nearly disappeared after the library began staying open later, showing the longer hours solved the issue.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct conclusion.
quests.passage: The clothing store's return policy used to require a receipt for every exchange, and staff often had to turn customers away. Since removing that requirement, exchanges have become quicker and customer complaints have dropped.
options: Returning items has become quicker and easier for customers.
The new policy made returns more difficult.
The store stopped accepting returns completely.
Customer complaints increased after the policy changed.
quests.correctAnswer: Returning items has become quicker and easier for customers.
quests.hint: Think about what became easier for customers after the policy changed.
quests.explanation: Exchanges became faster and complaints dropped after the store removed the receipt requirement, showing the new policy made returns easier.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct conclusion.
quests.passage: Before adding two-factor authentication, the company's accounts were broken into several times a month. In the six months since the security feature was added, there have been no reported break-ins.
options: Two-factor authentication made accounts easier to break into.
The company removed the security feature after complaints.
The number of break-ins had nothing to do with the security change.
Account security at the company has clearly improved.
quests.correctAnswer: Account security at the company has clearly improved.
quests.hint: Compare how often break-ins happened before and after the security feature was added.
quests.explanation: Break-ins stopped completely after two-factor authentication was introduced, strongly suggesting the feature improved account security.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct conclusion.
quests.passage: The warehouse used to have frequent minor injuries because workers rushed to meet strict daily quotas. After the company extended deadlines and added safety training, injury reports dropped by more than half.
options: Injuries increased after the new policies were introduced.
The warehouse removed its safety training program.
Workplace injuries were unrelated to the quota changes.
The warehouse has become a safer place to work.
quests.correctAnswer: The warehouse has become a safer place to work.
quests.hint: Compare injury reports before and after the company changed its policies.
quests.explanation: Injury reports fell by more than half after deadlines were extended and safety training was added, suggesting the changes made the workplace safer.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct conclusion.
quests.passage: Hikers rarely attempted the northern trail because the path was steep and poorly marked. After volunteers added clear signs and handrails last year, park rangers report three times as many hikers on that trail.
options: More hikers are choosing to use the northern trail than before.
Fewer hikers use the trail since the improvements.
The trail was closed after the improvements were made.
The number of hikers has stayed exactly the same.
quests.correctAnswer: More hikers are choosing to use the northern trail than before.
quests.hint: Think about how signs and handrails might change hikers' willingness to use a trail.
quests.explanation: Hiker numbers tripled after signs and handrails were added, suggesting the improvements made the trail safer and more appealing.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct conclusion.
quests.passage: The factory used to be extremely noisy, and several workers complained of ringing in their ears by the end of each shift. Since workers began wearing new protective earplugs, those complaints have stopped.
options: The earplugs made the ringing in workers' ears worse.
The new earplugs have stopped workers' ringing-ear complaints.
The factory stopped requiring hearing protection.
Ear complaints were unrelated to noise at the factory.
quests.correctAnswer: The new earplugs have stopped workers' ringing-ear complaints.
quests.hint: Compare workers' complaints before and after they began wearing the new earplugs.
quests.explanation: Complaints about ringing ears stopped once workers began wearing the new earplugs, suggesting the earplugs were protecting their hearing.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct conclusion.
quests.passage: The local arcade was nearly empty on weekday afternoons for years. After adding a few classic pinball machines that adults remembered from childhood, weekday visits from adults have more than doubled.
options: The pinball machines caused adult visits to decrease.
The arcade removed the pinball machines after complaints.
Adult visits stayed the same after the machines were added.
More adults are visiting the arcade on weekday afternoons now.
quests.correctAnswer: More adults are visiting the arcade on weekday afternoons now.
quests.hint: Think about why adults might be drawn to games from their childhood.
quests.explanation: Weekday visits from adults doubled after classic pinball machines were added, suggesting nostalgia drew more adult customers to the arcade.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct conclusion.
quests.passage: The Patel family's mailbox used to overflow with paper advertisements every week. After they added their address to a mail-preference list, they now receive almost no unwanted mail.
options: The family now receives more unwanted mail than before.
The mailbox was removed from their house.
The mail-preference list had no effect on their mail.
The family now receives far less unwanted mail than before.
quests.correctAnswer: The family now receives far less unwanted mail than before.
quests.hint: Compare how much mail the family received before and after joining the list.
quests.explanation: Unwanted mail nearly disappeared after the family joined a mail-preference list, showing the list worked as intended.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct conclusion.
quests.passage: The diner's soup used to be made from a powdered mix, and few customers ordered it. After switching to a homemade recipe using fresh vegetables, soup became one of the diner's best-selling items.
options: The homemade soup sold less than the powdered version.
The diner removed soup from its menu.
The recipe change had no effect on soup sales.
Customers are ordering the soup far more often than before.
quests.correctAnswer: Customers are ordering the soup far more often than before.
quests.hint: Compare how well the soup sold before and after the recipe changed.
quests.explanation: Soup sales rose sharply after the diner switched to a fresh, homemade recipe, showing customers responded well to the change.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct conclusion.
quests.passage: The Baker twins used to share a bedroom and argued constantly about space and noise. After their parents converted the attic into a second bedroom, the twins say they get along much better.
options: The twins argue with each other much less than they used to.
The twins argue more since getting separate bedrooms.
The twins still share one bedroom.
Bedroom space had nothing to do with the twins' arguments.
quests.correctAnswer: The twins argue with each other much less than they used to.
quests.hint: Compare the twins' relationship before and after they got separate rooms.
quests.explanation: The twins' arguing decreased once they had separate bedrooms, suggesting the shared space had been a major source of conflict.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct conclusion.
quests.passage: Attendance at the after-school science club used to average only five students per meeting. After the club started building small robots each session, weekly attendance rose to over twenty-five students.
options: Attendance dropped after the club started building robots.
Far more students are attending the science club now.
The science club was cancelled due to low interest.
The activities in the club had no effect on attendance.
quests.correctAnswer: Far more students are attending the science club now.
quests.hint: Compare attendance numbers before and after the club changed its activities.
quests.explanation: Attendance rose from five to over twenty-five students after the club began building robots, showing the new activity attracted much more interest.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and select the correct conclusion.
quests.passage: The hardware store used to organize tools by brand, and customers often struggled to find what they needed. After reorganizing the shelves by project type instead, staff say customers ask for help far less often.
options: Customers are finding what they need without asking for help as often.
Customers now need more help finding items.
The store returned to organizing tools by brand.
How the shelves are organized makes no difference to customers.
quests.correctAnswer: Customers are finding what they need without asking for help as often.
quests.hint: Think about why customers might need less help after the shelves were reorganized.
quests.explanation: Customers began asking for less help once the store reorganized shelves by project type, showing the new layout made items easier to find.
